title: The Theorem of Two Cans
statement: The task, a run-twice communication problem, is to encode a binary string of length n−1 (n up to 1000) as a connected graph on n vertices robust to an adversary deleting an edge of any simple even-vertex path and joining its endpoints. The deleted edge stays bridged by an odd path, so bipartiteness and the 2-coloring are invariant: the bipartition carries the string, a non-bipartite graph the all-zero one.
